programs.title: One Strange Rock
programs.desc: A story about the creation and history of the planet, the laws governing it, its shape, the richness of flora and fauna, threats to the natural environment, natural wonders and surprising relationships.Actor Will Smith and people who have had the opportunity to spend time in space will talk about this extraordinary place in the universe.Accounts from astronauts including Mae Jemison, Mike Massimino, Leland Melvin and Chris Austin Hadfield will provide a completely new perspective on Earth.Director Darren Aronofsky and his film crew visited 45 countries and six continents.The photos were taken, among others, in the Arctic, the Himalayas, India and during the annual festival in Tarragona, Spain.Materials recorded on board the International Space Station were also used.In the following episodes, viewers will learn how oxygen is produced, the protective layers of the Blue Planet and the entire sequence of events that led to the creation of life.The topic of death, colonization, destruction, the search for alien forms and human intellect will also be discussed.

programs.title: Europe From Above 2
programs.desc: Continuation of the sky expedition over the Old Continent.In the second series you will be able to admire, among others:the Greek Acropolis or the great icebreakers in Finland.

programs.title: Hostile Planet
programs.desc: There are places with extremely difficult conditions.Living there requires a constant fight for survival, adapting to fierce frosts, heat, storms, snowstorms and heavy rainfall.Access to these areas is often difficult.The situation is worsened by climate change and rare weather events that have impacted many species.The extraordinary cinematography by Guillermo Navarro, who won an Oscar for "Pan's Labyrinth", will better show this intriguing world where danger lurks at every step.

programs.title: America The Beautiful: Wild South West
programs.sub_title: The good, the bad and the deadly
programs.desc: There is a 146-kilometer area between California's Death Valley and Mount Whitney, the highest peak in California.The authors of the program travel through deserts, mountains and wetlands with their camera.

programs.title: Wildes Südafrika - Der 8. Kontinent
programs.desc: South Africa, like the entire continent, is very diverse.This is a place where cold-loving penguins live alongside ostriches that live in sandy areas.Sea snails and lively chameleons also thrive in this climate.South Africa has distinctive geographical features as well as extreme climatic conditions.Wild animals are exposed to constant changes in living conditions.On the west coast you can meet predatory sea lions that specialize in hunting young Cape boobies;in the south, giant crocodiles, lions and deer, and inland - elephants.

programs.title: Predator Fail: When Prey Attacks
programs.desc: When a predator attacks, potential prey usually has no chance.Sometimes, however, the would-be victim can surprise the attacker very much.
